tools.name: list_archetypes
tools.description:
The workout archetypes the generator makes, one per line: key, name,
    formats, minutes, line count, and the session slots it serves.

tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description:
The equipment suggest_workouts' `equipment` takes, one per line:
    key: name, with "(machine)" on ergometers (rower, ski erg, bikes).
    Keys, names and common names ("echo", "row erg", "DB", "kb") all work.

tools.name: find_movements
tools.description:
Movement slugs whose name holds `query` (e.g. "row", "sled"), for
    suggest_workouts' include and exclude, machines and runs first.

tools.name: suggest_workouts
tools.description:
New workouts from our generator, as text. Ask this instead of writing
    workouts yourself. Nothing is saved.

    Example, two people with an echo bike, rower and ski erg, 40-60 min:
    suggest_workouts(count=5, people=2, minutes_min=40, minutes_max=60,
    equipment=["echo-bike", "row-ergometer"

tools.name: vary_workout
tools.description:
Variations of one library workout from our generator (no AI), as
    text, in its own format or another. Nothing is saved.

    A shortfall says what blocked it.

tools.name: generate_workouts
tools.description:
New workouts unlike any in the library, from our generator (no AI),
    as text: evolved from the library's workouts and movements (more lines,
    fewer, other formats) into kinds it does not hold. For one person.
    Nothing is saved; other ones each call. suggest_workouts and
    vary_workout sta

tools.name: report_workout
tools.description:
A user's verdict on a workout from these tools: a mistake (wrong
    equipment, a weight, a dose that cannot fit), or a workout they found bad
    or good. Stores the user's words for Goblin Gains, nothing else about the
    user.
